qs.q: Which HPV subtypes are most strongly associated with condylomata acuminata of the vulva?
qs.e: HPV 6 and 11 are low-risk subtypes causing condylomata acuminata with low malignant transformation risk.

qs.q: The hallmark histologic feature of HPV infection seen in condylomata acuminata is
o: Psammoma bodies seen at papillary tips
qs.e: Koilocytosis — perinuclear cytoplasmic vacuolization with wrinkled nuclear contours — is the hallmark cytopathic effect of HPV infection.
